facts.summary: Pivotal trial missed primary and key secondary endpoints; development ceased · Phase 3 · eDSP in Ataxia-Telangiectasia · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Primary and key secondary endpoint did not achieve statistical significance
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: the primary endpoint, which measured the change from baseline to last efficacy visit at month six using the Rescored modified International Cooperative Ataxia Rating Scale (RmICARS) compared to placebo, did not reach statistical significance
evidence.safety: eDSP was generally well tolerated and there were no clinically meaningful safety concerns identified.
evidence.program_discontinued: Company to cease clinical development of eDSP; Intends to preserve cash and explore available options
